budget.name: Budget traveller
budget.description: Cost matters most, will accept a slower trip and a fixed ticket.

business.name: Business traveller
business.description: Needs a fast direct and changeable trip, price matters little.

flexible.name: Flexible tourist
flexible.description: Plans may change so a refundable, changeable ticket is  prioritized.

eco.name: Eco-conscious traveller
eco.description: Wants the lowest emissions, accepts at most one transfer.
